versions.content: Type for a role parameter II Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00072, SRS_Rte_00029 The type for a role parameter shall be the ImplementationDataType of the RunnableEntityArgument if • the RunnableEntityArgument references an ImplementationDataType AND • the serverArgumentImplPolicy of the RunnableEntityArgument is set to useArgumentType AND • no mapping to a BswModuleEntry is defined for the RunnableEntity .
